head: 6692c0ad501593963211748f33075b6874b9cfb0
scope: Create a self-contained standalone copy of Ouroboros' code-memory and code-intelligence backend under github.com/sltbrta/sentra-code-memory-v2. Preserve committed implementation parity for code crawl, durable incremental indexing, exact symbol indexing, code serving verbs, memory cortex/storage, hosted/local model clients, concurrency/worker pools, hardening, and low-latency warm paths. Add a simple coding-agent CLI with direct commands and JSONL protocol, rewrite module/import identities so no runtime/build dependency remains on Ouroboros, document independent setup and operation, run parity and smoke checks, and publish the initialized GitHub repository.
non_goals: Do not copy the macOS Spotlight app, TUI, evaluation/media worker, deployment stacks, or unrelated company-only UI surfaces.
Do not claim benchmark parity beyond checks run locally.
Do not add a remote service requirement for local indexing/search/memory.
Do not modify the source Ouroboros checkout.
risks: Large wholesale extraction may retain stale Ouroboros import paths or generated metadata.
Some copied services may assume monorepo Bazel/workspace files or unavailable external model credentials.
Changing generated protobuf import strings can break descriptors or consumers.
A public repository can expose accidental secrets or local artifacts if the source selection is wrong.
Full source parity may include more backend surface than the minimum code-only CLI needs.

phases.title: Add CLI contract tests and prove red
Rewrite identities and implement standalone CLI
Review extraction boundaries and test oracle
